summary: Extensions should expose provenance at the point of use, tailor views to a question, and route proposed corrections through reviewable write-back rather than editing derived pages directly.

items.text: Add role- and task-specific entry views that show only the smallest relevant system frame, then retrieve deeper code, trace, and decision evidence on demand.
Provide a provenance inspector for every derived element: source revision, query, generator version, freshness threshold, confidence, and known contradictory evidence.
Let users propose corrections from the companion, but materialize them as pull requests or queued source-artifact changes with conflict detection and ownership review.
Preserve historical snapshots and superseded rationale so incident reviews can reconstruct what a user could see at a past point in time.
